sources.title: Support — LocalMusic AI
sources.snippet: The app is downloading a large model on first launch. Is this normal? Yes. LocalMusic AI downloads the ACE-Step AI model (~4 GB) the first time you generate music. This is cached locally and only needs to happen once.

sources.title: Local deployment of large-scale music AI models on commodity hardware
sources.snippet: We present the MIDInfinite, a web application capable of generating symbolic music using a large-scale generative AI model locally on commodity hardware. Creating this demo involved porting the Anticipatory Music Transformer, a large language model (LLM) pre-trained on the Lakh MIDI dataset, to the Machine Learning Compilation (MLC) framework.
